stories.title: Out-of-control container kills father and son:Mother breaks down in constable's arms; truck overturns into drain after smashing four houses
stories.summary: An out-of-control container truck ran over a man and his son sleeping outside their house in Mirzapur on Thursday at 2:30 AM. After that, the container broke through four houses and overturned into a drain. In the accident, the father died on the spot, while family members took the seriously injured minor son to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Angered by the accident, family members and villagers blocked the Prayagraj-Mirzapur National Highway. During this time, the deceased's mother hugged a woman constable and broke down crying. Meanwhile, the minor daughter alleged that the ambulance arrived about an hour after being informed. Doctors came about 10 minutes after reaching the hospital. She said that if treatment had been provided on time, her brother could have been saved. Police present at the scene are trying to pacify the family members and villagers. The accident occurred near Gaipura Chowk in the Vindhyachal police station area, 25 km away from the district headquarters. At the time of the accident, the father and son were sleeping under a tin shed built outside their house. The case in detail On Prayagraj-Mirzapur National Highway near Gaipura intersection in Vindhyachal police station area, Shiv Prasad Gupta (35) lived with his family. He ran a scrap business. The family consists of wife Manju (32), daughter Divya (15) and son Rahul (13). After having dinner on Wednesday night, Manju and daughter Divya went inside the room to sleep, while Shiv Prasad and Rahul slept under the tin shed in front of the house. Late at night around 2:30 AM, a container loaded with cement (MH 19 ZQ 9901) went out of control and crashed through four houses, entered straight into their house and then overturned into the drain by the roadside. Shiv Prasad died on the spot after being hit by the container. Meanwhile, Rahul was seriously injured. Hearing the sound of the crash, people from nearby reached the spot and pulled both of them out from the debris. Ambulance arrived an hour late, doctor arrived 10 minutes late Villagers immediately called for an ambulance, but the ambulance arrived around 3:45 AM on Thursday morning after a delay of about an hour. Injured Rahul was taken to the Primary Health Centre in Sarroi, where doctors declared him dead. After the accident, chaos spread throughout the entire area. Upon receiving information, CO City Amit Kumar, Vindhyachal Police Station In-charge Ajit Kumar, Gaipura Chowki In-charge Suresh Chandra Dwivedi along with heavy police force reached the spot. Both bodies were sent for post-mortem. After the accident, the container driver fled leaving the vehicle behind. At the time of the accident, wife Manju and daughter Divya were sleeping inside the room, so their lives were saved. But with the death of her husband and only son in a single night, a mountain of sorrows fell upon her. Villagers protest on NH-45 Enraged by the incident, villagers blocked the Prayagraj-Mirzapur National Highway (NH-45). Their demand is that the height of the divider at the accident site should be increased and radium reflectors should be installed on it, so that vehicle drivers can get clear signals at night. The villagers say that if there had not been a drain alongside the highway, the container could have moved further ahead and engulfed several other houses as well, which would have resulted in even greater loss of life. After the accident, the administration called a crane to remove the container, but angry villagers protested and sent it back. They said that first their demands should be decided upon, only then should the vehicle be removed. Daughter says 10 accidents have occurred, administration hasn't still woken up Shiv Prasad's daughter Divya alleged that many accidents have occurred at this location before. “In the last few months, about 10 people have lost their lives at this very spot. We have demanded from officials several times to increase the height of the divider, but no one paid attention. At night many drivers drive vehicles at high speed after drinking alcohol, yet no effective action is taken against them,” she said. CO says case against driver, family will get assistance CO City Amit Kumar said: Both bodies have been sent for post-mortem. A case is being registered against the absconding container driver. Along with this, action will also be taken to provide financial assistance to the victim's family from the government level.

stories.title: Boyfriend shoots girlfriend after spotting another man's tattoo:Kills himself; victim girl critical with bullet lodged in head
stories.summary: In Meerut, a deranged lover died by suicide after shooting his girlfriend three times. According to the police, the lover was angry after seeing a tattoo with the name 'Aryan' on the chest of the 12th-class girl. On Wednesday evening, the man stopped the girl student as she was returning from tuition. The man asked about the name ‘Aryan’. When the girl refused to tell, the man started arguing. In a fit of rage, the deranged man pulled out a pistol from his waist and fired at the student. She fell, covered in blood. Hearing the gunshot, people nearby rushed to the spot. Fearing capture, the accused also shot himself in the chest. He died on the spot. People admitted the student Anushka (23) to Subharti Medical College. She had one bullet in her head and two in her stomach. Doctors have removed two bullets through surgery, while the third bullet is still lodged in her head. Her condition is critical. The deranged lover, Aditya (26), will be cremated on Thursday. He is a history-sheeter. More than 10 cases were registered against him. He had been released from jail on bail just 10 days ago. The incident occurred near Zonal Park in Defense Enclave Colony, Kankerkhera police station area. Girl's mother is a government teacher According to the police, Anushka is a resident of Govindpuri, Kanker Khera. Her mother is a government teacher at Sanatan Dharma Inter College in Sadar. Her father had passed away. She also has an elder brother in the family. Meanwhile, the accused Aditya was a resident of Shivlokpura Colony, Kanker Khera. Aditya had completed his ITI course from Saket ITI College in 2025. He was the younger of two brothers. His elder brother's name is Ashish. There is a distance of about 1 km between Aditya and Anushka's houses. Both belong to the Scheduled Caste. Three years ago, they became friends on Instagram, then started talking, and the friendship turned into an affair. Caught with an illegal pistol a month ago According to the police, Aditya had come into contact with arms dealer Sawej alias Shera, a resident of Lisari Gate. He had started supplying weapons to Aditya. About a month ago, the police arrested him with an illegal pistol and sent him to jail. After he went to jail, Anushka distanced herself from him. Released on bail 10 days ago, then started contacting her again About 10 days ago, Aditya came out of jail on bail. As soon as he came out, he called Anushka, but her number was switched off. Later, he stopped Anushka near her house. Then he found out that she had changed her mobile number. After that, he got her new number and started talking to her again. Stopped her while returning from tuition, then shot her Police said that on 27 July, Aditya had shared a picture of himself with Anushka on Instagram. During this, he saw a tattoo named 'Aryan' on Anushka's chest. After that, he kept asking about Aryan, but Anushka did not respond. On Wednesday evening, Anushka was returning on her scooter after tuition. Aditya followed her on a Pulsar bike. He stopped her on the way and started talking. When Anushka refused to talk, he pleaded. Somehow, he convinced Anushka to talk. After this, both reached near the Zonal Park of Defense Enclave. There, a dispute arose between them regarding Aryan, after which the accused fired a shot. SP City Vinayak Bhosale said: Two pistols, a scooter, and a Pulsar bike were found at the crime scene. First, there was an argument between the young man and woman. After this, the young man shot her. Their families are being interrogated. Further action will be taken after that.

stories.title: Oppn protests Ram Mandir donation theft in Parliament:Lok Sabha adjourned till 2 pm amid uproar; paper leak Bill to be tabled in Rajya Sabha
stories.summary: Opposition MPs staged a protest at Makar Dwar at 10:30 am on Thursday, ahead of the start of Parliament's proceedings. They demonstrated against the Centre over the police action against student protesters at Jantar Mantar on 20 July and the alleged theft of donations at the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. Priyanka Gandhi joined the protest. As soon as the Rajya Sabha convened, Opposition MPs raised slogans and questioned the police action in the NEET paper leak case before staging a walkout. The Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026, related to paper leaks, will be introduced in the Rajya Sabha at 2 pm. The debate is expected to last around seven hours, with Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge set to participate. In the Lok Sabha, members are scheduled to discuss the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026. The paper leak Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha on Wednesday after nearly seven hours of debate. The government described it as a major step against paper leaks, while the Opposition argued that increasing punishments alone would not solve the problem and that broader reforms to the examination system were also needed.

stories.title: Maulana sets himself ablaze:Claims wife tortured him; runs through Bareilly street engulfed in flames as she chases him screaming
stories.summary: In Bareilly, a Maulana, fed up with his wife, set himself on fire by dousing himself with petrol. The Maulana, who was severely burnt, died on Wednesday evening during treatment. CCTV footage of the incident has also surfaced, in which he is seen running on the road engulfed in flames. His wife is also seen running behind him. The brother of the deceased, Abdul Qadir (28), has filed a complaint with the police, accusing his sister-in-law of instigating the self-immolation. Meanwhile, Abdul, in a statement given to the police during treatment, said that his wife, along with her brother, wanted to usurp his property. When he resisted, she used to harass him. He said, "I don't even want to see her face now. Fed up with her harassment, I took this horrific step." Police have started an investigation based on the deceased's last statement and the CCTV footage of the incident. Family members and neighbours are being questioned. The case belongs to the Fatehganj Paschimi police station area. See 2 pictures First, let's understand the whole matter in a sequential manner Narrated his ordeal to the police before dying Abdul told the police that his wife used to quarrel, assault, and abuse him over small matters. Two years ago, she had also filed a case of dowry harassment and domestic violence. However, later, a settlement was reached by mutual consent. For a few days, everything was fine, but later, she, along with her brother, started physically and mentally torturing me. She was pressuring me to transfer the house into her name. “If I refused, she would resort to violence,” he had said. "She would falsely accuse me of having affairs with other women and threaten to send me to jail. I was very troubled by her. Now I didn't want to stay with her for another moment," he said. What did the CCTV footage show? The 2-minute 5-second CCTV footage shows the street deserted, some children playing, and a girl going to school with a bag. Then, Abdul, wearing a kurta-pajama and a cap, is seen entering the house with two bottles of petrol in his hand. Sixteen minutes later, Abdul, engulfed in flames, runs out of the house. His wife runs behind him, screaming for help. After this, people come out of their houses. Chaos erupts in the street. CO Highway Devesh Singh stated: Upon receiving information about a youth's self-immolation, the police reached the hospital. He died during treatment. The CCTV footage has been seized, and action is being taken based on the evidence.

stories.title: Punjab fraud worth ₹90 crore:Fake companies floated in youth's name using one Aadhaar card and two photos; office emptied before raid
stories.summary: Ten years ago, a young man's Aadhaar card was taken under the pretext of sending him abroad. Now, using the same Aadhaar number with a different photo, a network of fake billing worth ₹90 crore has been set up. This scam, uncovered during a GST investigation in Varanasi (Uttar Pradesh), reached Chet Singh Nagar in Ludhiana. UP Police had prepared to reach the rented office by tracing the IP address, but a stay order on the search warrant was obtained from the court before the raid. When the Dainik Bhaskar team reached the spot, the house was found locked. Neighbours claimed that a few days ago, people had removed goods from upstairs during the night. Meanwhile, the young man whose name was used for the rent agreement and Aadhaar clearly stated that he had never been to Ludhiana. The question also arises: if the Aadhaar was used fraudulently, then who is Harvinder, who obtained the stay from the court? Know the story of the fake billing scam in sequence Learn how the Ludhiana Aadhaar card was manipulated From search warrant to stay, know the story If Harwinder Singh's Aadhaar is fake, then who filed the writ? Advocate Sarvjeet Singh says that when it became clear that the Aadhaar card on which the rent agreement was made belongs to Harwinder Singh of Jagraon. Only the photo has been changed in it. That Harwinder Singh says that he neither ever rented a house in Ludhiana nor did he ever come to Chet Singh Nagar. Now the question arises that when the rent agreement has been made fraudulently, then which Harwinder has filed a petition in court for a stay order. He said that an investigation should be conducted in this regard. Neighbours said the accused left from the parapet at night Local residents say that the landlord had rented out the house. Three or four people used to come here, do their work, and leave. They had no dealings with anyone. They informed that the house has been closed for three or four days. The police came but left from outside. They say that at night, some people climbed up using a ladder from outside, opened the upstairs door, and left from the parapet. No one knows what belongings they took with them. Could not search due to stay on search order UP Police investigating officer Kapil Kumar Yadav says that he had obtained a search warrant from the court, but in the meantime, the Sessions Court issued a stay, and now the file has been requested from him. He stated that he went to Jagraon and took Harwinder's statement, and Harwinder showed his new Aadhaar card. The Aadhaar card number on his Aadhaar card and the rent agreement is the same. The photo has been changed. The address on the Aadhaar card is also of his other house.

stories.title: Who was the first Kanwar pilgrim, Ram or Ravan?:4 crore devotees to perform jal abhishek; how has the Yatra changed over decades
stories.summary: Millions of Kanwariyas on the roads, saffron clothes on their bodies, Kanwar on their shoulders and 'Bol Bam' on their lips The month of Sawan has started today. Devotees of Shiva have set out to fetch Ganga water for Jalabhishek. Shivalayas in UP are fully decorated. The highest number of Kanwariyas in the country walk in Uttar Pradesh, followed by Uttarakhand, Haryana and Delhi. During Sawan, the highways of Western Uttar Pradesh are completely filled with Kanwariyas. The situation is such that the economy of the areas through which the Kanwar Yatra passes also picks up pace. It is estimated that this time, business worth about ₹8,000 crore can be done in the month of Sawan. There are different beliefs about Kanwar from West to Purvanchal. Some consider Lord Ram as the first Kanwariya, some Ravana and some Shravan Kumar. Understand the rules of Kanwar and Kanwariyas in the graphics below

stories.title: First day of Sawan:Yogi performs jal abhishek at Kashi Vishwanath, tours Varanasi's lanes; long queues at Shiva temples in Ayodhya and Prayagraj
stories.summary: Today is the first day of Sawan. Since Thursday morning, long queues of devotees have been seen at all major Shiva temples, including Varanasi, Prayagraj, and Gorakhpur. In Kashi, Baba Vishwanath was adorned with flowers. Since Mangala Aarti, more than 50,000 devotees have had darshan of Baba. CM Yogi reached Kashi at 8:30 AM. He first had darshan of Kaal Bhairav and performed Aarti. After this, he performed Jalabhishek of Baba Vishwanath and offered Bhasma (sacred ash). He also roamed through the lanes of Kashi. He asked shopkeepers, "Are there any shortcomings in the arrangements?" He caressed a child sitting in a shop and gave him a chocolate. Yogi instructed officials to make arrangements so that devotees do not face any difficulty in darshan and worship. It should be noted that, like last year, VIP darshan will be prohibited at Kashi Vishwanath Temple throughout Sawan this time as well. Meanwhile, a stream of Kanwariyas has started appearing on the roads and highways of the state. Today, an important meeting will be held in Bareilly regarding the Kanwar Yatra, which will be attended by DGP Rajiv Krishna, Principal Secretary SP Goyal, and DMs of nine districts. New guidelines may be issued in the meeting.

stories.title: Constable kidnaps girl from hospital, murders her at cremation ground:Body dumped in river; accused previously jailed for molestation
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, UP, a constable kidnapped a 10-year-old girl from the district hospital. He murdered her and threw the body into the river. On Wednesday at 8:30 AM, the police recovered the body based on the accused constable's information. Police suspect that the girl was murdered after being raped. According to the police, the deceased girl's elder sister is admitted in the district hospital. On 28 July, the victim girl had come to the hospital to give food to her sister. While returning home, the accused constable took the girl with him on his bike. When the girl did not reach home, her family filed a missing person report. Police had deployed 10 teams for the investigation of the case. When CCTV footage was scanned, the constable was seen with the girl. When the police apprehended him and interrogated him strictly, he confessed to the crime. The accused constable, Abhishek Yadav, is posted in Dial-112 in Gorakhpur. He has previously been jailed in a rape case involving a girl from Bengal. He was also suspended. Details of the case The father, a resident of Kaptanganj police station area of Azamgarh district, filed a complaint on Wednesday. In it, he stated that he has been living on rent with his family in Gorakhpur for the past four years. He supports his family by driving an e-rickshaw. On 27 July, his 13-year-old elder daughter fell ill and was undergoing treatment at the district hospital. “On 28 July at 8:30 PM, my second 10-year-old daughter went to the hospital with food. After feeding her sister, my daughter left for home around 10 PM. After a long time passed, she didn't reach home; I went to the hospital to check. She wasn't there either. We inquired here and there. We searched everywhere, but couldn't find her anywhere,” the victim's father said, Accused asked, 'Does anyone want to go home?' The 13-year-old sister admitted to the hospital said her younger sister brought food. “We were sitting outside eating when a person in a police uniform came and asked where we lived. When we told him our address, he then asked if anyone wanted to go home. 'Tell me, I'll drop you off',” she recalled. The admitted sister said that she would not go; only her younger sister would go. Since then, that uniformed person started pursuing her. When she was going to get water, he was following her. Finally, when she started leaving for home, he followed her for some distance. Accused seen putting her in the vehicle in CCTV This entire incident was captured on CCTV. The 39-second footage shows the girl walking out of the hospital. From behind her, the accused, still in uniform, goes on a bike and stops near her. He talks for a while, then the girl sits on his vehicle, and both leave. She is the second among five sisters The 13-year-old sister admitted to the hospital said, “My mother is pregnant. That's why she doesn't feel well. We are five sisters. My sister and I take care of everyone. On 27 July, around 7 PM, my health suddenly deteriorated. I started having chest pain and a very high fever.” “Dad immediately took me to the hospital. Doctors admitted me. Grandma stayed with me at the hospital. On 28 July, the second sister cooked food with her own hands. Due to Dad not being home and Mom being sick, she brought the food herself with the third sister. Then, after telling the third sister to stay at the hospital and feeding her, she started to leave. That's when this incident happened,” she said.

stories.title: Meerut Kanwar pilgrim swept away in Ganga, rescued by SDRF:2 houses washed away in Saryu in Ballia; rain alert issued for 41 cities
stories.summary: The monsoon has slowed down in Uttar Pradesh, but heavy rainfall in the hills has caused rivers to overflow. In Haridwar, a Kanwar pilgrim from Meerut was swept away in the strong current of the Ganga on Wednesday. An SDRF (State Disaster Response Force) personnel jumped into the river and saved his life. Meanwhile, erosion by the Saryu River has intensified in Ballia. Floodwater has entered villages, forcing more than 100 families to leave their homes and shift to safer places. Two houses have been washed away into the river, while the land beneath several other houses has eroded. These houses could collapse into the river anytime. In Gonda, the water level of the Ghaghra River has reduced, but erosion has increased further. Several bighas of farmland and trees have been washed away into the river. Meanwhile, satellite images show that clouds have disappeared from nearly 70-80% of Uttar Pradesh. According to the India Meteorological Department (IMD), the monsoon system has weakened for now. The low-pressure area formed over the Bay of Bengal has moved towards central India, slowing down monsoon activities in UP. The IMD has issued a rain alert with thunderstorms for 41 districts today. Heavy rainfall is expected in 10 cities of western Uttar Pradesh. Earlier on Wednesday, 59 districts received rainfall, with Kanpur recording the highest rainfall at 81 mm. Three Weather Pictures Weather likely to change in 1st week of August Lucknow Meteorological Centre senior scientist Atul Kumar Singh said that the monsoon system may move northwards again around August 3-4. He said moist winds coming from the Bay of Bengal are expected to strengthen, due to which monsoon activities will pick up again and bring good rainfall across the state. Rain Forecast for July 30 Agra: Sunshine Since Morning, No Rain Expected Agra witnessed bright sunshine since Thursday morning. Winds remained calm, causing people to face humid conditions once again. According to the Meteorological Department, clouds may appear during the day, but there is no possibility of rain. Kanpur: Cloudy Weather, Rain Likely With Thunderstorms Light clouds covered Kanpur on Thursday morning. Winds kept the weather pleasant. The morning temperature was around 30°C. Weather expert Dr SN Sunil Pandey said there is a possibility of rain with thunder and lightning during the day. Lucknow: Clear Weather, Clouds May Appear Later Lucknow witnessed clear weather and bright sunshine on Thursday morning. The Meteorological Department has predicted movement of clouds during the day. So far this monsoon season, Lucknow has received 176.4 mm rainfall against the normal average of 304.4 mm. This means the city has received 42% less rainfall than normal. Ballia: Two Houses Collapse Into Saryu, Dozens More at Risk Erosion by the Saryu River continues in Gopalnagar Tadi area of Bairia tehsil in Ballia. Strong river currents washed away two residential houses, creating panic among villagers. Fearing further damage, residents are dismantling their houses and shifting essential belongings to safer locations using tractor-trolleys. Haridwar: Meerut Kanwar Pilgrim Swept Away in Ganga A major accident was averted during the Kanwar Yatra in Haridwar when a pilgrim was swept away while bathing at Kangra Ghat in the Ganga. The SDRF team stationed at the spot rescued the youth through quick action. After being rescued, the Kanwar pilgrim was given primary treatment and his condition was found to be stable. The pilgrim was identified as 23-year-old Manish, a resident of Surajkund village in Meerut. He was taking a bath in the Ganga when he suddenly entered deep water. Constable Nitesh Khetwal jumped into the river without worrying about his own safety and safely pulled him out. Clouds Disappear Over UP in Satellite Images Low Rainfall Expected in UP During Monsoon IMD Director General Dr M Mohapatra said that conditions similar to La Nina in the Pacific Ocean have ended and there are signs of movement towards El Nino, which could result in lower rainfall. He said there are indications that the southwest monsoon may remain weaker than normal this year. Less snowfall in the Northern Hemisphere between January and March may also impact monsoon activity.

stories.title: IAS officer who took 7 bullets clashes with Jalaun official:Asks, 'Which order says inquiry files cannot be shown? I will leave immediately'
stories.summary: A dispute broke out over an inspection at Urai Nagar Palika Parishad in Jalaun on Wednesday. IAS officer Rinku Singh Rahi reached the municipal office at around 2 pm and began examining files related to alleged irregularities. The move was objected to by the Executive Officer (EO) present there, leading to a heated argument between the two officials. Rinku Singh Rahi told the EO, “Show me the order. Which order says that I cannot be shown the records? Show me that order and I will leave immediately.” The EO alleged that Rinku Singh Rahi had arrived with some private individuals who were recording videos while checking the files. The inspection was linked to an ongoing probe into corruption allegations at Urai Nagar Palika Parishad. Rinku Singh was part of the investigation team when he was the SDM of Jalaun. However, after his transfer to Urai, his role in the committee ended. Now the complete matter in detail The dispute arose after councillors of Urai Nagar Palika Parishad submitted a complaint regarding corruption allegations to District Magistrate Rajesh Kumar Pandey. Following the complaint, a three-member inquiry committee was formed on June 18, 2026, under the chairmanship of Additional District Magistrate (Namami Gange) Premchand. The committee included then SDM Rinku Singh Rahi as an ex-officio member and Public Works Department (Provincial) Executive Engineer Amit Saxena as another member. After Rinku Singh Rahi’s transfer, ADM Premchand issued an order on July 17, 2026, appointing current Jalaun SDM Rakesh Kumar Soni as the ex-officio member of the committee. This ended Rinku Singh Rahi’s role in the inquiry. Rinku Singh is no longer a member of the inquiry committee Municipal EO Ram Achal Kuril alleged that Rinku Singh Rahi demanded access to inquiry-related files. He said he informed the IAS officer that he was no longer a member of the inquiry committee and therefore the files could not be shown to him. The EO said providing all files at closing time was not possible and that if any government document went missing amid the crowd, fixing responsibility would become difficult. Rinku Singh Rahi, however, accused the EO of trying to influence him and make him act in his favour. People present at the spot recorded videos of the entire incident. After repeated requests by municipal employees, Rinku Singh sat down and examined the files. Now read the conversation between the two officers Rinku Singh Rahi- Show me the order. Which order says I cannot see the records? Where is it written that I should not be allowed to inspect the documents? Show me that order and I will leave immediately. Please show me the records. EO Ram Achal Kureel- Sir, you are such a senior officer. I do not want to argue with you. Take whatever you need. Rinku Singh Rahi- Give it to me in writing that I will not be shown the records. If there is any order saying I cannot inspect the documents, I will leave without objection. I have also written a letter regarding this today. EO- No sir, you are a senior officer. I do not want to argue. Rinku Singh Rahi- You are not cooperating. I will have to report this. You came to set things up with me, but I do not believe in such arrangements. You wanted me to adjust with you, but I do not accept such things. EO- No sir, we had made the records available for you. You can sit here and conduct the inquiry. All documents can be checked here. How can we take so many records from August 22 to 26 outside? If files go missing, who will be responsible? Rinku Singh Rahi- That is why I have come here myself. EO- Sir, please sit down. You can also verify from anyone. Rinku Singh Rahi- I have already sent a letter to the DM. I am making it clear that I will not leave from here. The EO requested Rinku Singh Rahi to follow the administrative order and respect the decision of the revised inquiry committee. However, both officials remained firm on their positions. The situation normalised after the entire incident was recorded on video. Later, Rinku Singh Rahi left the municipal office.

stories.title: Will UP's 2 MLAs face jail under anti-paper leak law?:Bedi Ram, Vipul Dubey have faced trial for 20 years; conspiracy proven, but no conviction
stories.summary: The Centre has introduced the Anti-Paper Leak Bill following protests by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) over the NEET paper leak. The new law includes two key provisions. First, trials in paper leak cases must be completed within three months of the chargesheet being filed. Second, all such cases will be heard in fast-track courts. Amid the renewed focus on paper leaks, former Uttar Pradesh IPS officer Amitabh Thakur has brought the 2006 Railway Group D paper leak case back into the spotlight. Two MLAs from BJP ally parties are among the accused in the case. It is being heard by a Special MP-MLA Court, which functions like a fast-track court. However, even after nearly 20 years, the court has only reached the stage of framing charges, holding that the accused had allegedly conspired to leak the examination paper. A total of 22 accused, including Subhaspa MLA Bedi Ram and Nishad Party MLA Vipul Dubey, are currently out on bail. Some of the accused have died over the years. Bedi Ram represents the Jakhania Assembly seat in Ghazipur, while Vipul Dubey is the MLA from Bhadohi. MLA appeared after court's reprimand 9 cases in election affidavit, most related to paper leaks In his election affidavit, Bedi Ram disclosed nine criminal cases, most of them related to recruitment exam paper leaks. These include cases linked to the Railway Group D examination, Railway Loco Pilot recruitment, Bhopal-Jaipur Railway recruitment, Madhya Pradesh PCS, Ayurveda recruitment and Chhattisgarh CPMT recruitment. Courts have already framed charges in eight of these nine cases. All are currently under trial, but no verdict has been delivered so far. Bedi Ram is considered a close aide of Subhaspa chief and Uttar Pradesh Cabinet Minister Om Prakash Rajbhar. Dainik Bhaskar contacted Bedi Ram by phone to seek his response. His personal assistant answered every call, saying the MLA was busy and would respond later. However, no response was received. Gangster Act on Vipul Dubey, said- Will not say anything right now According to Nishad Party MLA Vipul Dubey’s election affidavit, he is facing a case under the Gangsters Act linked to the 2006 Railway Group D paper leak. During its investigation, the STF described him as a close associate of Bedi Ram in the alleged racket. In July 2024, the court framed charges against him. He is currently on bail and the trial is continuing. Speaking on the case, Vipul Dubey said the matter is pending before the High Court and therefore he would not comment. Know why the accused will not come under the purview of the new 'Anti Paper Leak Law'? The Centre has implemented the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 2024 to curb malpractice and organised cheating in competitive examinations. Uttar Pradesh has also enacted a stringent state-level anti-paper leak law. These laws provide for imprisonment ranging from three to 10 years and fines of up to ₹1 crore for those found guilty. Supreme Court lawyer Shariq Abbasi said Article 20(1) of the Indian Constitution guarantees that a person can only be punished under the law that was in force when the offence was committed. If a harsher law is introduced later, it cannot be applied retrospectively to increase punishment for an earlier offence. Former IPS officer complained to Chief Minister Former IPS officer Amitabh Thakur wrote to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on July 26, saying there is widespread public anger over paper leaks. He noted that both the Centre and the Uttar Pradesh government have adopted a zero-tolerance policy on such offences and urged that long-pending paper leak cases should also be pursued with the same seriousness. Thakur has specifically sought effective prosecution in the paper leak cases involving Subhaspa MLA Bedi Ram and Nishad Party MLA Vipul Dubey.

stories.title: VIDEO | Husband performs last rites for living wife:Posts WhatsApp status calling her 'Late'; wife alleges domestic abuse
stories.summary: In Firozabad, a man performed the 'pinddaan' (a Hindu ritual for the deceased) of his living wife. He also posted the video on his WhatsApp status. In the video, he is seen bathing at the ghat after performing the pinddaan on the banks of the Yamuna. He had also written 'late' with his wife's picture. When the woman saw her pinddaan video, she was stunned. On Sunday afternoon around 2 PM, she reached Linepar police station. She accused her husband and in-laws of harassment. She filed a complaint against all of them with the police. 3 pictures of the pinddaan Finally, the ritual of performing 'Pind Daan' for the living wife was completed by lighting a lamp on the banks of Yamuna. Now know the whole matter Married in 2014, accused of dowry harassment Deepa Swarnkar, a resident of Nagla Vishnu, filed a complaint with the police on Sunday. She stated that she was married to Jitendra Prakash in 2014. Since the marriage, her husband, mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and brother-in-law have been mentally and physically harassing her, demanding dowry. Deepa says that on July 30, 2026, her in-laws assaulted her. Feeling her life was in danger, she hid in the room. She somehow saved her life. She also has an audio recording of her husband threatening to kill her. Posted a video of Pinddaan on WhatsApp status According to the complaint, on August 2, her husband performed her Pind Daan while she was still alive. He posted a video of this on his WhatsApp status. When she protested, her husband said that she was dead to him and would no longer stay with her. Deepa stated - she has two small children. The entire family is mentally disturbed by this whole incident. She has demanded that the police register an FIR against all the accused, including her husband, take legal action, and ensure the family's safety. Inspector Ramit Kumar Arya said- The woman's husband is an alcoholic. There was a quarrel between the husband and wife. In anger, he performed his wife's 'pind daan' (a Hindu ritual for the deceased). The husband is currently absconding. He is being searched for. Action will be taken.

stories.title: Man kisses burqa-clad woman outside her home:Woman returned from shopping; says, 'He grabbed me from behind, I was left shaken'
stories.summary: A burqa-clad woman was allegedly kissed by a molester outside her house in Moradabad before he fled. A 22-second video of the July 28 incident later surfaced. After examining footage from 25 CCTV cameras, police arrested the accused on Saturday and sent him to jail on Sunday at 2 pm. The case falls under the Katghar police station area. The 22-year-old woman said she remains frightened and traumatised. She said, If something like this can happen at my own doorstep, where will women be safe? I was just entering my house and never imagined such an incident could happen in my own neighbourhood. She praised the police for their swift action in arresting the accused and demanded the strictest possible punishment to ensure he does not commit such a crime again. See 4 pictures Read the full news sequentially Grabbed girl from behind and kissed her It was around 4 PM on the evening of 28 July (Tuesday). There was silence in Karula Gali No.-3, located on Sambhal Road. A girl living here had gone to do some shopping at the weekly market held on the roadside on Tuesday. After shopping, the girl returned home. The girl was wearing a burqa. A young man started following her from the market. He followed the girl all the way to her house. Meanwhile, the girl reached her house and knocked on the gate so that someone inside could open it. At the same time, the young man who was following her grabbed the girl from behind. He kissed the girl. As soon as the girl screamed, the young man quickly ran away. Mother filed FIR at police station, accused arrested After the incident, the girl went inside the house and told her family everything. After this, the family members checked the CCTV cameras installed in the neighborhood. The young man's face was clearly visible. On 29 July, the girl, along with her mother, went to the police station with the CCTV footage and filed a complaint. Police scanned footage from about 25 CCTV cameras to identify the accused. The search for the accused young man began with the help of photos and videos. On the night of 1 August, the police apprehended the young man. He has been identified as Mukesh (28), a resident of Milak Basera Khas village in Kundarki. Police presented Mukesh in court on Sunday and then sent him to jail. Victim recounts ordeal After the accused, Mukesh, was sent to jail, the victim said she was returning home around 4 pm on Tuesday when he approached from behind as she knocked on her door, grabbed her and kissed her. She raised an alarm, prompting him to flee. Although the street was deserted, the incident was captured on nearby CCTV. She expressed satisfaction with the police action and demanded the harshest punishment for the accused. Mother demands strict action The victim's mother said they were asleep when their daughter knocked on the door. They only learnt about the incident later after watching the CCTV footage. She said women should feel safe at their own doorsteps and welcomed the accused's arrest, demanding strict punishment. SP City Ranvijay Singh said the incident occurred on July 28 while the woman was talking on the phone outside her house. The accused approached, committed an obscene act, and fled. Police registered a case, identified him through CCTV footage, arrested him, and sent him to jail.

stories.title: Schoolgirl hangs herself following police interrogation:Father in Saudi Arabia blames officers after two youths leak explicit video in Ballia
stories.summary: Distressed by the viral circulation of an explicit video, a 15-year-old girl ended her life by hanging in Uttar Pradesh’s Ballia district. The incident occurred shortly after a police sub-inspector visited her home at 1:30 pm on Saturday to conduct questioning, during which he filmed the premises and put questions to the teenager. Exactly ten minutes after the officer departed at 2:00 pm, the girl was found hanging. Family members discovered her and rushed her to a local hospital, where she succumbed to her injuries at around 5:00 pm later that evening. Following the incident, the victim's father released a video statement from Saudi Arabia levelling serious allegations against the local police force. "My wife had lodged a named FIR two days prior regarding the creation of explicit videos and subsequent blackmail. The police detained two suspects, but released one of them after taking a bribe," the father alleged. He added that officers were conducting a biased investigation and failed to invoke the POCSO (Protection of Children from Sexual Offences) Act despite the victim being a minor. "Instead of taking action against the accused, police repeatedly came to our house to interrogate my daughter and record video footage. Harassed and distressed by these actions, my daughter took her own life. Had the police taken timely and fair action, she might still be alive today," he stated. The tragic incident took place approximately 35 kilometres from the district headquarters. The 15-year-old victim, a Class 7 pupil, lived with her mother in a village under the jurisdiction of Maniyar police station. Her father works in Saudi Arabia, while her elder brother—who had recently returned to the village—is employed in a private firm in Hyderabad. On 31 July, the girl's mother filed a formal complaint at the local police station against two villagers, identified as Zahid and Ismail. According to the complaint, Zahid had groomed the teenager and drawn her into a relationship. During their phone conversations, he surreptitiously recorded an explicit video of her. Following this, the primary suspect and three of his accomplices began blackmailing the victim. They subjected the girl to continuous pressure to meet with them and forced her to accept a marriage proposal. When she refused, they threatened to circulate the explicit footage on social media. Upon her final refusal to meet the suspect, the explicit video was transmitted to several of his acquaintances and uploaded across social media platforms. Distressing details have emerged from the victim’s cousin, who revealed that police had initially apprehended two suspects but released one after allegedly taking a bribe. "Sub-Inspector Ismail Shaikh arrived at our house on Saturday afternoon to conduct an enquiry. He inspected the premises and questioned my sister. Roughly 10 to 15 minutes after his departure, she hanged herself," the cousin stated. Describing the desperate attempt to save her, he added: "We immediately rushed her to the local Community Health Centre, from where she was referred to the district hospital. As her condition deteriorated, doctors advised moving her to Mau Medical College. Tragically, she passed away on the way to the hospital at around 5:00 pm." The victim's brother further accused the investigating officers of intimidation and incompetence: "For the past two days, the police were doing nothing under the guise of an investigation except harassing our family. They kept coming to our home and recording videos for no valid reason. Instead of interrogating the accused, they were grilling us."

stories.summary: A Kanwariya from Haryana, returning with Kanwar from Haridwar, was severely beaten on the way. In Manglaur, Haridwar, a Kanwar was broken due to a collision with his vehicle. Local youths immediately surrounded the vehicle and started vandalising it. All the windows of the vehicle were shattered with sticks and rods. After this, a youth jumped repeatedly on the car's roof, denting it. When the victim protested, he was dragged out of the vehicle. A video of this incident has also surfaced, in which some Kanwariyas are seen hitting an S-Presso (Maruti Suzuki) with sticks. The rear door of the car was also bent. After the incident, chaos continued on National Highway-58 till late at night. Upon receiving information, the police reached the spot. Considering the seriousness of the matter, the police registered a case and arrested the local youth accused of vandalism, Raja alias Rajesh. Read the full case in detail Main accused arrested, search for others ongoing Considering the seriousness of the matter, the police started an investigation. Police investigation revealed that local youth Raja alias Rajesh (resident of Kamelpur, Roorkee) is the main accused in the vandalism and commotion. Police have arrested Raja, while efforts are underway to identify and arrest two-three other unknown Kanwariyas and youths involved in the incident.

stories.title: Gen Z trapped PM Modi In reel culture, claims Akhilesh:SP leader redefines BJP as party of the corrupt, tyrannical, and sinful
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav on Sunday said, “The BJP calls itself the world's largest party, but they trapped the Prime Minister himself in the process of making reels. Then Gen-Z made a reel of the Prime Minister. Now when I see Instagram, it makes me very sad.” Akhilesh was referring to PM Modi's recent Instagram content and reels made for the youth. In the last 10 days, PM Modi has made five videos on Instagram, in which he is seen presenting his views before youngsters and students. During the press conference in Lucknow, Akhilesh said, “BJP means 'Corrupt, Oppressive, and Sinful'. This party can never be loyal to anyone. If there is any biggest crisis in UP today, it is BJP. Until this government is removed, the state's crises and the public's problems will not be resolved.” The SP chief also honoured two artists who came as Hanuman and Ram during the press conference by giving them ₹51,000 each. The artist who became Hanuman had danced during BJP President Nitin Nabin's roadshow in Lucknow on 4 July. There was a lot of controversy in the matter. Lawyers, including opposition parties, had objected and demanded an FIR. Key points from Akhilesh's press conference- 1. Destroyed the education system, eliminated employment opportunities Akhilesh Yadav said, “Earlier, there used to be theft in fertiliser sacks. Now, the entire sack is being stolen. They talked about doubling farmers' income but nothing happened. The potato farmer is ruined. There is no legal guarantee for MSP. The education system has collapsed. Employment opportunities have also been destroyed. If there are no jobs, there will be no reservation.” 2. Corruption happened on the expressway, offerings were stolen The SP chief said if E-20 increases mileage, companies should advertise it. There has been large-scale corruption on the expressway. Public funds have been stolen. Regarding Jauhar University, the intention and motive have not been right from day one. They don't want people to study. They couldn't build this university. They want to hammer it down. These issues will be raised in the assembly. 3. 26,000 schools closed in 10 years, reservation posts were stolen Akhilesh Yadav said 26,000 schools were closed in 10 years during BJP's rule. As many as 26,386 schools were closed in the name of merger. The highest number of primary schools were closed in Lakhimpur. Papers of more than 20 examinations have been leaked. More than 12,000 reservation posts for backward classes and Dalits have been stolen. Ever since we started providing data, the government website has been shut down. Those who claim to make India a 'Vishwaguru' (world leader), the reality is that 7,000 schools do not have electricity. Two-thousand schools do not have functional toilets for girls. Five-hundred schools do not have water arrangements. Twenty-three-thousand schools do not have computers.

stories.title: Lucknow police officer suspended for sexual harassment:BEd student claims SSI demanded favours in exchange for favourable medical report
stories.summary: SSI Dharamveer Shahi of Ashiana police station, accused of sexually exploiting a B.Ed student in Lucknow by promising marriage, has been suspended. The young woman alleges that the sub-inspector called her to the police station and said, “Your rape case is old. If you have relations with me once, the medical report will come out correct.” The victim alleges that the sub-inspector called her to his room at the police station and had physical relations with her. After that, he sexually exploited her multiple times by promising to strengthen her case and marry her. The matter pertains to Ashiana police station. The victim had filed a case against Abhishek Singh, a resident of Basti, accusing him of having physical relations by promising marriage. SSI Dharamveer Shahi was investigating this case. It is alleged that on February 21, he called the victim to Ashiana police station. After that, they met several times. When the student pressured him for marriage, on the night of July 30, the accused assaulted her and snatched her mobile phone. After this, the young woman complained to the Police Commissioner and DCP Central. After investigation, an FIR was registered against the accused, SSI Dharamveer Shahi, and he was suspended. First, read what the victim said... In a conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, the victim stated that she had completed her B.Ed. During her studies, she met Abhishek Singh, a resident of Shankhpur, Basti. Abhishek made physical relations with her on the pretext of marriage and later backed out of the marriage. After this, the woman filed a case against Abhishek in Basti. The case was transferred to Ashiana Police Station in Lucknow under zero FIR. The victim stated that during the investigation, when the crime scene was found to be in the PGI police station area, the case was transferred there. It is alleged that despite this, SSI Dharamveer Shahi, the investigating officer posted at Ashiana Police Station, concealed this information and called her for questioning on February 21. He said that he would conduct the entire investigation of the case. After this, he started calling her continuously in the name of investigation. The victim alleges that during the conversation, he also started making obscene remarks. Established a relationship by claiming the medical report was old The victim alleged that Dharmveer Shahi said, “Your case has become quite old. To connect it with the current incident, you will have to have physical relations again. When she protested, the sub-inspector assured her of marriage.” He said that if she had a relationship with him, he would support her for life, give her the status of a wife, and marry her. The victim alleges that under the pretext of marriage, she was sexually exploited from March until now. Secret revealed during trip to Banaras The victim stated that about a month and a half ago, she went to Banaras with the sub-inspector. There she found out that the sub-inspector was already married. Knowing this, she became upset. When she talked about marriage, the sub-inspector started procrastinating. The victim alleges that when she pressured him for marriage, the sub-inspector assaulted her with kicks, punches, and slaps. He hit her head against the wall and said, “I have kept you only for fun. You are equal to my shoe.” Allegation of Assault Again on the Night of 30 July The victim alleges that on the night of 30 July, around 11 PM, when she went to Apollo Hospital to get medicine for her mother, Dharamveer Shahi called her to Ashiana Police Station. There, along with his two associates, he assaulted her again. It is alleged that an attempt was made to knock her unconscious by hitting her head with a heavy object. Her hands were twisted and an attempt was made to break them, causing swelling in her hands. Additionally, her mobile phone was snatched while threatening to kill her and run her over with a vehicle. Allegation of snatching mobile to destroy evidence The victim alleges that Dharamveer Shahi snatched the mobile phone to erase the chats, photos, videos, and other evidence present in it. According to the complaint, the accused threatened that if she complained to the authorities, he would defame her everywhere. He also said, "I will get you and your family killed. I have connections with senior police officers, so the police won't be able to harm me." The victim states that since these threats, she and her family are scared. Now know in which case the student had filed a complaint About a year ago, the student became friends with Abhishek Singh, a resident of Basti. It is alleged that he repeatedly had physical relations in Lucknow by promising marriage and later refused to marry. In this case, an FIR was registered at Chhawani police station in Basti in February 2026. Through a Zero FIR, the case reached Ashiana police station, from where it was transferred as the incident site fell under the PGI police station area. It is alleged that during the investigation of this case, the student met the then investigating officer, SSI Dharmveer Shahi. The victim says that the sub-inspector lured her under the pretext of investigation and later sexually exploited her. After he refused to marry her and assaulted her, the student complained to the DCP Central, based on which a case was registered against the accused SSI and he was suspended. DCP Central said - FIR registered, accused sub-inspector suspended DCP Central Vikrant Veer said: A case has been registered. The accused SSI has been suspended. The investigation of the case has been handed over to ACP Cantt. Further action will be taken based on whatever evidence comes to light during the investigation.

stories.title: Drove car in reverse, evaded police for 7 km:Theft suspect escaped after stopping on Agra Expressway; only female friend found
stories.summary: A car theft accused dodged the police in cinematic style on the Agra-Lucknow Expressway. The police, who had been searching for him for a long time, tried to stop the accused's car at the Fatehabad toll, but the accused drove the car in reverse (in back gear) for 500 meters on the wrong side. After that, he turned the car around and sped off. He evaded the police for about 7 km. Then he abandoned the car and fled towards the fields with his accomplice. The police found the accused's female friend in the car parked on the expressway. After questioning, the police released her. Several luxury cars were stolen The incident occurred on Friday afternoon around three o'clock. A month ago, several luxury cars parked outside bungalows in Jaipur House (Lohamandi police station area) and Kamla Nagar police station area were stolen. A special team was deployed for the investigation. Police had received information that a vehicle theft accused from Hardoi was heading towards Lucknow via Mathura in a stolen car. Based on this information, the police were alerted at the Rahankalan toll on the Inner Ring Road. The car passed the Rahankalan toll. Police surrounded the vehicle at Fatehabad Toll Plaza The vehicle theft accused proceeded towards Fatehabad in his car. Dauki police were deployed at Fatehabad Toll Plaza. Toll staff lowered the barriers, causing a jam. The car-borne ringleader was with a companion and his female friend. Car punctured by police bullet, accused kept driving Seeing the police, the accused put the car in reverse gear. He drove the car in the wrong direction for about 500 meters. After this, he brought the car into another lane and drove it towards Agra for 7 km. Police fired and punctured the car, but he kept driving it. At Ramada Cut, after stopping the car, the accused got out and fled with his companion. Police found the accused's female friend in the car. She was brought to the police station and interrogated. The accused is a resident of Hardoi DCP City Syed Ali Abbas stated that police had received clues in car theft cases from Jaipur House and Kamla Nagar. Following this, a special team of police was engaged in the investigation. On Friday, information was received from an informant that an accused named Abhishek Vajpayee from Hardoi was passing through Mathura along with his female friend and companion. Following this, a cordon was laid, but he managed to escape. A team has been deployed for his arrest.

stories.title: Mayawati expels nephew’s father-in-law:BSP supremo sacks Ashok Siddharth after repeated warnings, rules out any return
stories.summary: Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) supremo Mayawati has expelled Ashok Siddharth—the father-in-law of her nephew Akash Anand—from the party. Speaking on Sunday, the BSP chief stated that Siddharth had failed to mend his ways despite repeated warnings, adding that he would never be readmitted into the party ranks. In a sweeping organisational crackdown, Mayawati also expelled Randhir Singh Beniwal. Beniwal served as a BSP national co-ordinator and oversaw party affairs across Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu Kashmir. Second Expulsion in 18 Months This marks the second time in 18 months that Mayawati has expelled Ashok Siddharth. He was previously ousted on 12 February 2025 over allegations of factionalism, before being reinstated six months later in September 2025. Siddharth previously held charge of BSP operations across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Gujarat, Chhattisgarh, and Delhi. Mayawati had stripped him of these state responsibilities on Saturday, triggering media speculation that he might be reassigned to lead party affairs in Uttar Pradesh. Accusations of Misinformation Trigger Final Ouster Addressing the reports on Sunday, Mayawati posted on X (formerly Twitter) to clarify that Siddharth was stripped of his duties due to unreformable behaviour. She accused him of orchestrating a conspiracy to mislead party workers by leaking false reports about a potential return to Uttar Pradesh politics, stating that this breach of discipline necessitated his permanent expulsion. Ramji Gautam Promoted; Cadres Warned Against Saboteurs Following the expulsion of Ashok Siddharth and Randhir Singh Beniwal, BSP supremo Mayawati has reappointed Rajya Sabha MP Ramji Gautam as the party's in-charge for Punjab. He will hold the position through the upcoming Punjab Assembly and Lok Sabha elections. In a further realignment of state responsibilities, Madhya Pradesh in-charge Rajaram has been handed additional oversight of Delhi, Kerala, Gujarat, and Karnataka. Mayawati Enforces Strict Structural Boundaries Clarifying party policy on executive roles, Mayawati stated that party office-bearers or co-ordinators hailing from Uttar Pradesh who hold key responsibilities outside the state will strictly not be assigned any organisational duties within UP. Concurrently, the party has stripped Nitin Singh—a close associate of Ashok Siddharth who served as his deputy across three states—of his responsibilities in Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu. Call to Safeguard Majority Ambitions Reissuing a stern warning to rank-and-file workers, Mayawati urged party cadres to remain vigilant against malicious elements and conspirators. She noted that such individuals are actively working to undermine the BSP's campaign to form a full-majority government. Prior Expulsions for Factionalism and Indiscipline Last year, in 2025, BSP supremo Mayawati had similarly ousted Ashok Siddharth and his close confidant, Nitin Singh, over allegations of fostering factionalism within the party structure. At the time, Mayawati publicly accused both leaders of orchestrating anti-party conspiracies. The internal crackdown escalated on 2 March when Mayawati stripped her nephew, Akash Anand, of his official post, before expelling him from the party the following day. However, following a formal apology, Akash was reinstated into the party fold on 13 April. Ashok Siddharth was subsequently readmitted six months later. Demonstrating a rapid return to influence, he was placed at the very top of the national office-bearers' list in February 2026, before his latest and final expulsion. Only Mayawati Has Authority to Finalise Candidates BSP supremo Mayawati had explicitly clarified that the absolute authority to select election candidates rests solely with her. She emphasised that Akash Anand and other senior leaders only announce candidates' names at cadre conventions, acting strictly on her directives. In line with this protocol, Akash Anand is scheduled to visit Hathras on 10 August to formally announce the BSP candidate. Strict Oversight Imposed on Akash Anand Clarifying Akash Anand's operational role within the organisation, Mayawati laid down two binding conditions: Nationwide Review Meetings Subject to Full Reporting: While Akash Anand is tasked with conducting review meetings across the country, Mayawati must be kept fully informed of every movement. State in-charges have been directed to send detailed progress reports directly to Lucknow or Delhi. Prior Clearance Mandatory for UP Programmes: Should Akash Anand plan any tour or public programme within Uttar Pradesh, both he and the attending party co-ordinators must obtain explicit prior approval from Mayawati. Ashok Siddharth: The eye surgeon who turned politician Born on 5 January 1965, Dr Ashok Siddharth is an ophthalmologist by profession, holding a diploma in eye diseases from Maharani Laxmi Bai Medical College. During his tenure in government medical service, he actively served as an assembly, district, and zonal president within BAMCEF. In 2007, while posted at the Gursahaiganj Primary Health Centre in Kannauj, he resigned from public service to join the Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP). He served as a Member of the Legislative Council (MLC) on a BSP ticket twice—first in 2009 and again in 2016—before being elected to the Rajya Sabha in 2016, where he served until 2022. Within the BSP, he held prominent organisational roles, including Kanpur-Agra zonal co-ordinator. In addition to serving as BSP National Secretary, Siddharth held state charge across five key regions, including Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala. His wife, Sunita Siddharth, served as the Vice-Chairperson of the Uttar Pradesh Women’s Commission from 2007 to 2012. Known as a low-profile strategist, Siddharth historically operated as a key behind-the-scenes operative within the party. Randhir Singh Beniwal: Sacked Months After High-Level Appointment Hailing from Saharanpur district, Randhir Singh Beniwal is a prominent leader from the Jat community who joined the BSP in 1990. BSP supremo Mayawati had appointed him as a National Co-ordinator in March 2025. Beniwal’s exit comes after a flurry of rapid organisational shifts; Mayawati had removed him from his charge of Himachal Pradesh and Jammu Kashmir just four days prior, only to briefly reinstate him alongside Ramji Gautam over Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, and Jammu Kashmir a day later—before his final expulsion from the party.

stories.title: Fourth-grade boy beaten to death in Gorakhpur:Child waylaid by 8 to 9 youths while he was on his way to uncle's shop
stories.summary: Nine-year-old Saras Singh, who was injured in a fight that took place on Saturday night at Bela intersection in Pipraich police station area of Gorakhpur, died during treatment. His 15-year-old maternal cousin, Shivkumar, is seriously injured and is undergoing treatment at BRD Medical College, Gorakhpur. After the incident, there is an atmosphere of grief and anger in Madhopur village. Family members have raised questions, accusing the police of not taking timely action. According to information, Raju Singh, a resident of Madhopur village, had filed a complaint at Pipraich police station about a month ago against some people, accusing them of molesting his daughter. Family members allege that after the complaint, the accused party was angry, and due to this, tension persisted between both sides. Family members say that if the police had taken effective action in the molestation case in a timely manner, perhaps the incident that occurred on Saturday night could have been avoided. However, the police are investigating the matter and all allegations are being probed. Attacked by surrounding them at Bela intersection It is reported that around 9 PM on Saturday night, Raju Singh's 15-year-old son Shivkumar and his brother-in-law Arvind Singh's 9-year-old son Saras Singh were going towards Bela intersection. Saras Singh used to live and study at his aunt's house in Madhopur after his mother's death. It is alleged that during this time, some residents of Kewatan Tola, Madhopur, surrounded both children. After this, they attacked both with sticks, iron rods, and bricks/stones. In the attack, both teenagers were seriously injured and fell on the road. Upon receiving information about the assault, nearby people reached the spot, after which the attackers fled from there. Local people informed the police and family members about the incident. Death during treatment at Medical College After the incident, both injured children were taken to Community Health Centre Pipraich. Seeing their serious condition, doctors referred them to BRD Medical College Gorakhpur. According to family members, 9-year-old Saras Singh died during treatment around 2 AM. Meanwhile, Shivkumar's condition remains serious. He is being treated under supervision at the medical college. As soon as the news of Saras's death was received, there was an uproar in the family. Family members are in a bad state, crying inconsolably. Mourning has also spread throughout the village. The deceased's family members alleged that despite informing the police about the incident, the police arrived late at the scene. They say that instead of taking immediate action, the police tried to calm the matter down and facilitate a compromise. Family members alleged that if the police had taken the ongoing dispute seriously and acted on time, this incident would not have happened. However, police officials say that a fair investigation of the matter is being conducted and no culprit will be spared. Police engaged in search for accused After the incident, the police have intensified the investigation of the case. Following the death of the minor, preparations are being made to add necessary sections to the case. Police are raiding potential hideouts to arrest the accused. Considering the tension in the village, police forces have been deployed. Officials have appealed to the villagers to maintain peace. Pipraich Station House Officer Vivek Trivedi stated that all aspects related to the incident are being investigated. Further action will be taken based on the medical report, statements of eyewitnesses, and other evidence. He said that if the investigation confirms the minor's death due to the attack, then relevant sections will be added to the case, and strict action will be taken against the accused.

stories.title: 17-year-old girl sexually exploited in Gorakhpur:Youth arrested for luring victim to room with marriage promise, fled after she became pregnant
stories.summary: A case has come to light in the Gulriha police station area of Gorakhpur where a 17-year-old minor girl was raped on the pretext of marriage. During physical relations, the minor became pregnant. As soon as this information was received, the accused fled. Based on the complaint filed by the victim's mother, Gulriha police have registered an FIR against the accused youth and arrested him. Details of the case According to police, a 17-year-old minor girl living in a village in the area has alleged that Vinay, a resident of Jungle Ekla Number-Two, Tola Hatwa, trapped her in a love trap and promised to marry her. After this, the accused had physical relations with the victim several times. Following this, the victim became pregnant. The victim alleges that upon learning about the pregnancy, the accused switched off his mobile phone and broke contact with her. After this, the minor told the entire incident to her mother. On Saturday, the mother reached Gulriha police station with her daughter and filed a complaint against the accused. CO Gorakhnath Ravi Singh informed that based on the complaint, an FIR has been registered against the accused under relevant sections and the POCSO Act. The accused has been taken into custody and is being interrogated.

stories.title: 57 UP districts on rain alert:10-foot snake enters kitchen in Lakhimpur, 6 Bijnor villages flooded as bullock carts wade through waist-deep water
stories.summary: Monsoon activity is set to pick up pace again in Uttar Pradesh starting today (Sunday). Over 30 districts, including Lucknow, Kanpur, and Gorakhpur, are witnessing overcast skies alongside gentle breeze. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a rain alert for 57 districts, warning of heavy rainfall in Gorakhpur and eight surrounding districts. Meanwhile, heavy relentless rainfall in the hilly region has pushed 10 rivers in UP — including the Ganga, Ghaghra, and Saryu — above the danger mark. In Lakhimpur Kheri, a 10-foot-long Russell's Viper slithered into the kitchen of a home on Saturday morning at around 11:00 AM. Following an alert, a Forest Department team reached the spot and safely rescued the venomous snake. In Bijnor, the swollen Ganga River has inundated six villages, leaving 12 others completely marooned like islands. Water levels on roads have reached up to 3 feet to 4 feet, forcing villagers to wade through waist-deep water using tractors and bullock carts. Floodwaters are also flowing over the state highway near the Ganga bridge. Similarly, in Varanasi, the rising Ganga has submerged the steps of several key ghats, with floodwaters entering 50 to 60 temples. Prior to this, 29 districts recorded rainfall on Saturday, with Mirzapur receiving the highest precipitation at 13 mm. Atul Kumar Singh, a meteorologist based in Lucknow, stated: "Over the next 24 hours, the monsoon trough will rapidly shift towards Uttar Pradesh, triggering an increase in monsoon activity across the state. Light rainfall is expected across most parts of the state, except for seven to eight districts. Heavier rainfall is set to begin tomorrow, with widespread, intense downpours likely across the entire state until August 6–7.

stories.title: 'I want my soul to keep wandering':Bodybuilder shoots himself dead in Saharanpur after writing, 'Don't let my wife touch my body'
stories.summary: A 52-year-old degree college clerk died by suicide in Uttar Pradesh's Saharanpur district on Saturday evening after shooting himself with a homemade firearm at his residence. The victim, identified as Devdutt Sharma—who was also a bodybuilder—took the extreme step at around 7:00 PM at his home located within the Sarsawa police station limits, approximately 30 kilometres from the city centre. Hearing the gunshot, Devdutt's wife rushed to the spot and found him lying in a pool of blood. He was immediately rushed to a medical college hospital, where doctors declared him dead. Before committing suicide, Sharma sent a lengthy WhatsApp message to his niece explaining his actions. "I can no longer tolerate the humiliation," the message read. "It is better to die once than to die every day. I am not a coward, but this humiliation has killed my soul from within. Do not let my wife touch my body." In his final note, Sharma also outlined specific instructions regarding his last rites, expressing a desire for his soul to remain restless. "Do not use cow dung cakes for my cremation, nor spend much money on it. No religious ceremonies should be performed for the peace of my soul; I want my soul to keep wandering. Take care of your mother," he wrote. Local police have launched an investigation into the matter. Family background Devdutt was a resident of Railway Road. His parents passed away several years ago. He was the elder of two siblings; his sister, Rajni (45), was married to Saharanpur resident Sachin Sharma, who passed away three years ago. It was to Sachin's 21-year-old daughter, Neha Sharma, that Devdutt sent the message prior to committing suicide. Devdutt married Seema Rani (49) 33 years ago. Apart from his wife, he is survived by two sons. The elder son, Abhishek, works in Dubai, while the younger son, Aditya, is studying forensics in Chandigarh. Aditya is also a powerlifter who recently won a gold medal in Dehradun by lifting 135 kg in the 74 kg category. Ran gym for 26 years alongside clerical job Devdutt had been running a facility named 'Rock Gym' behind his house since the year 2000. For the past two years, he was also employed as a clerk at Balaji Group of College in the city on a monthly salary of ₹17,000. He would manage the gym after returning from his college duties. Previously, Devdutt had also worked at Tilak Ram Saini Girls College and Elamchand Saini Girls College. Watch 3 reels of Devdutt below: Neighbours rushed after wife raised alarm A neighbour, Sushil, stated that Devdutt Sharma had gone to the gym on Saturday evening. According to his wife, Devdutt returned home from the gym around 7:00 PM and shot himself point-blank with a firearm. "His wife, Seema, came screaming into the gym," Sushil said. "I rushed inside and found Devdutt lying on the floor with a gunshot wound and a firearm lying next to him. We then took him to the hospital in a car, where he died." Following information about the incident, Station House Officer (SHO) Pravesh Kumar Sharma arrived at the scene alongside a police contingent and a forensic team. The forensic experts collected evidence from the spot, while officers questioned residents. Providing details on the matter, Circle Officer Pawan Kumar stated: "Prima facie, it appears to be a case of suicide. Investigations revealed a suicide note sent by the deceased to a relative, which is currently being verified. The victim's wife and family members will be questioned, and further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the complete probe."
